product_metadata.title: Now Designs Terracotta Pinch Bowls, Set of 6, 1 oz, Multicolor
features: PINCH BOWL SET: Keep your ingredients close at hand like a professional chef with this set of 6 small pinch bowls. They feature a beautiful array of colors in their glazed interiors with unglazed terracotta exteriors
VERSATILE VESSELS: Use these tiny bowls as serving dishes for condiments, snacks, candy & other finger foods. Great for meal prepping or as a small jewelry dish or trinket tray
CHARMING DETAIL: Each pinch bowl has a 2.75 inch diameter, stands 1 inch tall and can hold 1oz. These earthenware clay pinch bowls should be washed by hand
HOUSEWARMING GIFT FOR NEW HOME: Packaged in a gift-ready box, these pinch bowls make a great addition to any hostess, wedding or housewarming gift
STYLISH KITCHEN: For over 50 years, Now Designs kitchen textiles & accessories have been consistently recognized for their superior colors, trends, designs & unsurpassed quality & workmanship
description: Keep salt, spices and nuts at the ready with a set of six terracotta pinch bowls by Now Designs. The earthenware clay terracotta construction creates a striking contrast against the beautiful glazed, glossy hues in this small bowl set. Each small pinch bowl features a beautiful glazed interior and unglazed exterior to highlight the natural beauty of terracotta. These prep bowls/pinch bowls measure 2.75 inches in diameter and are 1 inch tall. Care: hand wash. Proudly made by Now Designs. For 50 years, Now Designs has created kitchen textiles, table linens and accessories that are consistently recognized for superior colors, trends, design and unsurpassed quality and workmanship.
